content.short: Alpha Art is a Solana-based NFT marketplace.
content.description: Alpha Art is an NFT marketplace focused on Solana-based tokens. Users can connect their wallets, browse listings, place offers, and trade Solana NFTs on Alpha Art, enjoying a streamlined wallet-to-wallet trading experience. In addition, the platform enables holders of Piggy Sol Gang NFTs to earn Solana by owning and staking those NFTs, adding a passive reward. Developers can submit listing requests to present their items to the community and help projects reach collectors. Notably, Alpha Art does not charge listing fees, making it free to list items for creators and traders alike.
